answer:
MAIN WORK COMPLETE — all six artifacts produced at their native paths and validated.

═══ WHAT WAS RUN ═══
`analysis.py` (executed end-to-end, ~4 min, numpy/scipy only — scikit-learn is unavailable in this environment and pip install fails offline, so elastic net is hand-implemented via Gram-based coordinate descent). Three independent methods were built, cross-validated internally, combined with a single threshold pass, and signs/hubs/metrics were derived from that exact topology.

• Method A — time-course derivative regression: replicate-averaged trajectory, smoothed derivatives (w=5, dt=0.612), per-gene degradation rate γ profiled over a 10-point grid with 5-block CV over an 8-point λ grid; stability from 120 bootstraps (3-of-5 replicate resampling + replicate-sd Gaussian noise). Mean blocked-CV R² = 0.92 (median 0.97 — largely smoothness on a ~rank-3-excited trajectory, caveated in the JSON).
• Method B — steady-state elastic net: per-gene regression across 16 conditions, λ by leave-one-condition-out CV, stability from 200 12-of-16 subsamples, near-noise predictors (std < 0.05) excluded. LOO-CV R² = −6.9 and LOO predictive R² = −8.0: reported honestly and explained — held-out conditions frequently intervene directly on the target gene, which no steady-state model can predict; these are structurally pessimistic proxies, not model failure evidence.
• Method C — intervention-deconvolution EM: alternates (i) per-gene elastic-net production-function fits on conditions where the target gene is NOT directly intervened and (ii) sparse intervention-set re-estimation from equation residuals, seeded with exact-to-zero clamps; overexpression cells emerge as residual outliers. Converges to 40 intervention cells with clean separation (non-intervened residual max 0.52 vs intervened-cell residuals ~10). Stability from 50 condition-subsample EM reruns; mean stability of freq≥0.5 edges = 0.80. Stable cells match the clamped sets (e.g., condition 7→genes {6,8,11,18}, condition 5→{5,11,14,23}) and identify overexpression targets (gene 9 in the +2336% condition; gene 15 in P2; gene 1 in the 12× condition).

Method overlap at freq≥0.5: A∩B 35 edges (Jaccard 0.13), A∩C 38 (0.14), B∩C 33 (0.24) — genuinely complementary evidence channels.

═══ COMBINATION & FINAL NETWORK ═══
Confidence = weighted mean of selection frequencies (A 0.20 / B 0.42 / C 0.38; A down-weighted for its rank-3 excitation). The confidence distribution is gap-free (values at density ranks 5/8/10/15/20/25/40% = 0.63/0.52/0.48/0.41/0.36/0.31/0.20), so the max-gap rule degenerates; density was fixed at 15% (mid-band, robust hubs). ONE threshold pass (τ = 0.411) produced the final topology; signs, hubs and metrics all derive from it with no re-thresholding.

• inferred_network.npy: (25,25) float64, no NaN/Inf, diagonal 0, 90 off-diagonal nonzero edges = 15.00% density (within 5–40%), all values ≥ 0 (strength magnitudes, standardized-coefficient scale).
• edge_sign_predictions.npy: 71 positive, 17 negative, 2 uncertain (0) among kept edges; 0 exactly wherever network == 0 (verified). Sign = normalized weighted sign vote; |vote| < 0.15 → uncertain.
• hub_genes.json: hubs = genes 10 and 20. Out-degrees 7 and 6 (max in network), out-strengths 0.54 and 15.48. Gene 10's edges are supported by B (0.52–0.76) and C (0.22–0.86); gene 20's by C (0.82–0.92 on 5 edges) and A.
• network_metrics.json: n_edges 90, density 0.15, in-degree 0–12 (mean 3.6), out-degree 0–7 (mean 3.6), sign counts, [target,source] convention stated.
• method_comparison.json: all four method entries with description, score + metric_name, stability, strengths, limitations, rationale, plus an explicit note that all metrics are internal proxies, not ground-truth accuracies.

═══ GENE-20 CROSS-CHECK (as requested) ═══
Naive regression (without the noise-floor filter) produced artifact-prone g20-source edges (sign flips when its one informative condition is dropped; e.g., g20→g16 flips +3.5/−11.1). After the filter and within Method C's intervention-aware fit, g20's outgoing edges are stable (freq 0.82–0.92 for →g6/g14/g15/g23/g24) and mechanistically coherent: the single condition with a genuine g20 perturbation (+0.32, +44%) drives g16 −11.8, g18 −17.4, g24 −6.4 (negative regulation) and g14/g15 up (positive) — consistent with B's large negative g20→{g18,g16,g24} coefficients. Conclusion: gene 20's hub status is NOT a regression artifact; it is documented in method_comparison.json ("gene20_diagnostic") either way.

═══ SIGN SPOT-CHECK ═══
Against intervention asymmetries (knockdown of k should decrease positive targets/increase negative targets; overexpression the reverse): 64/97 checkable kept edges (66%) consistent. This is a rough diagnostic — indirect/cascade effects corrupt single-condition checks — reported as such.

═══ DENSITY SWEEP (sensitivity; final artifacts use only the 15% pass) ═══
5%: 30 edges, top out-deg (7:3, 15:3, 3:2) — hub calls unstable at very low density.
10%: 60 edges, top (2:4, 22:4, 20:4).
15%: 90 edges, top (10:7, 2:6, 20:6) — chosen.
20%: 120 edges, top (20:8, 2:7, 24:7).
25%: 150 edges, top (2:9, 10:9, 20:9).
40%: 240 edges, top (20:15, 19:14, 10:13).
Genes 2, 10, 20 are consistently top influencers across 15–40%; the final top-2 {10, 20} are stable members of that set.

═══ VALIDATION CHECKLIST (all passed, asserted in analysis.py) ═══
Shapes (25,25) float64; no NaN/Inf; diagonal exactly 0 in both matrices; off-diagonal density 15.00% ∈ [5%, 40%]; sign matrix ∈ {−1,0,+1} and 0 wherever network == 0; hub_genes.json has exactly 2 genes; all six artifacts present at native paths (analysis.py, inferred_network.npy, edge_sign_predictions.npy, hub_genes.json, method_comparison.json, network_metrics.json).

═══ LIMITATIONS (also recorded in the JSONs) ═══
No ground truth is available; every reported metric is an internal proxy. The time series are 5 near-identical replicates (r≈0.999) of one trajectory with ~rank-3 excitation, so Method A cannot alone identify the ODE (a naive fit extrapolates to absurd steady states) and was weighted 0.20. Method B operates at p=24 > n=16. Method C's edge/intervention tradeoff is regularization-sensitive (λ=2 collapses toward "everything is an intervention"; λ=1 chosen by stability). Cascade-vs-direct-clamp ambiguity for exact-zero genes remains. All proxy numbers (CV R², stability, residual RMS) should be read as relative comparisons between methods, not accuracies.
